source.author: verg
source.text: Unam, quae Lycios fidumque vehebat Oronten, ipsius ante oculos ingens a vertice pontus in puppim ferit: excutitur pronusque magister volvitur in caput; ast illam ter fluctus ibidem torquet agens circum, et rapidus vorat aequore vortex.
source.text_original: Unam, quae Lycios fidumque vehebat Oronten, / ipsius ante oculos ingens a vertice pontus / in puppim ferit: excutitur pronusque magister / volvitur in caput; ast illam ter fluctus ibidem / torquet agens circum, et rapidus vorat aequore vortex.
source.text_english: One ship, which was carrying the Lycians and trusty Orontes, a huge wave from above strikes on the stern before the very eyes of all: the helmsman is thrown out and falls headlong, turned over onto his head; but that ship the wave thrice there twists and drives round, and the swift whirlpool engulfs it in the sea.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illam huc atque illuc nunc torquens verberat Eurus, nunc stridens Zephyris aufert Notus; undique fervent aequora, cum subitus trifida Neptunus in hasta caeruleum fundo caput extulit.
reuse.text_original: illam huc atque illuc nunc torquens verberat Eurus, / nunc stridens Zephyris aufert Notus; undique fervent / aequora, cum subitus trifida Neptunus in hasta / caeruleum fundo caput extulit.
reuse.text_english: Now Eurus, wrenching it hither and thither, beats it, now Notus, screaming among the Zephyrs, carries it off; the seas boil on every side, when suddenly Neptunus, with his three-pronged spear, raised his blue head from the depths.
